name: Blink
description: In the inspected Blink Windows source, WinSparkle is initialized with the configurable updater_url, whose default is an HTTPS appcast URL; this checkout contains no application-level DSA/EdDSA key configuration, while WinSparkle DLL verification remains unresolved.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot, not the historical Blink release under study.
WinSparkle DLL/framework source and its runtime signature policy were not reviewed; absence of a key in Blink's Python wrapper is not evidence that the external library cannot verify signatures.
